name: dsh-crew
description: Dispatch DeepSeek workers running in DSH from Codex, with multi-turn sessions.

interface.longDescription: Exposes the dsh-crew MCP server: dispatch a task to a DeepSeek worker running inside DSH, answer its needs_input questions in the same turn with dsh_worker_message, and follow every turn through one stable jobId/sessionId pair.
defaultPrompt: Use dsh_run_worker to dispatch this task to a DSH worker, then report jobId and sessionId when it settles
